I have been farming this same plot for many years, and I keep my own groundnut seeds from the last harvest because they have always served me well. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or medicine for the crops from the shop, and God provides the rain in Mtwara, so I do not need irrigation. My children and grandchildren will help me with planting, weeding, and harvesting, but we cannot afford to pay anyone to work for us.
